info.name: What the Yellow King Goblin Wants

descriptions.notStarted: The Guardian Spirit says the Goblins of Kamak Mountain are the only ones that know something about the Old Fox. Go see the #bYellow King Goblin#k at #bDokebi House#k near the Haunted House.
descriptions.inProgress: The Yellow King Goblin says he will tell everything about the Old Fox only if I get him #b1 plate#k of his favorite #broasted pork#k. Let's go buy roasted pork from the Folk Town.  #k  \n\n#i2022050##t2022050#/1
descriptions.completed: The Yellow King Goblin revealed the spell the Old Fox uses.
